# Studios-Pro

> All-in-one browser-based 3D & 4D design suite, multi-color 3D printing toolkit, WebAR viewer, and CNC/Laser CAD hub. 100% client-side WebGL/WebAssembly processing in English and French.

## Core Facts
- **Website**: https://studios-pro.com/ (French: https://studios-pro.com/fr/)
- **Pricing**: Free tier includes 5 exports across all studios with zero software installation; Studios-Pro Premium costs $10 USD/month for unlimited exports, commercial license, and full access across 24+ creative studios.
- **Privacy**: 100% local in-browser GPU/WebGL processing; uploaded photos, STL/3MF meshes, and DXF/SVG blueprints never leave the user's device.
- **Supported Formats**: STL, OBJ, 3MF (Bambu Lab AMS / OrcaSlicer / Prusa MMU), GLB / GLTF 2.0, PLY, USDZ / WebAR, DXF, SVG, G-Code, WAV, MP4 / WebM, Standalone Interactive HTML.

## Flagship Creative Studios
- **Filament Painting & Layer-Swap Studio** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/filament-painting-studio/): Free browser alternative to HueForge with Linear-RGB Kubelka-Munk TD optics, smartphone Camera TD calibration, 250+ filament spools (.hfp import), CMYW color lithophanes, and native Bambu/Orca auto-swap 3MF export.
- **Multi-Color 3MF Painter** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/multicolor-3mf-painter/): Paint STL and 3MF models directly in the browser with AI Auto-Color, smart fill, purge waste calculator, and native multi-part 3MF export for Bambu AMS & OrcaSlicer.
- **3D QR Wi-Fi Coaster & Sign Generator** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/qr-wifi-coaster-generator/): Generate scannable 3D Wi-Fi, restaurant menu, SEPA, and Airbnb QR coasters, table tents, magnets, and caddies in 3MF, STL, and DXF/SVG.
- **New 3D 4D Relief & GLB Studio** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/new3d4d/): Convert 2D photos into ultra-smooth 3D bas-reliefs, lithophanes, coins/medals (STL/OBJ), and animated 4D GLB & 60 FPS video clips.
- **PolyMorph 3D Studio** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/polymorph-3d/): Universal 3D format converter plus procedural watch movements, Cryptex puzzle boxes, Sugihara optical illusions, Pepakura papercraft unfolder, RPG dungeon tiles, flexi articulated models, and Voronoi vases.
- **AR Viewer 3D** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/ar-viewer/): Instant WebAR projection for STL, OBJ, and GLB models on iOS QuickLook and Android SceneViewer via QR code with no app download.
- **ArtGen Studio** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/artgen/): Procedural vector logos, 45+ AI art styles, 3D relief STL/OBJ/GLB export, and DXF recoloring.
- **Scripting Studio PRO** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/scripting-live/): Parametric 3D CAD JavaScript IDE with real-time Three.js CSG, planetary gearboxes, live parameters, and STL/OBJ/GLB/AR export.
- **4D Figure Builder PRO** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/figure-builder/): Real 4D polytopes (Tesseract, 16-Cell, 24-Cell, 120-Cell), Photo-to-4D sculptural conversion, W-hyperplane slicing, GLB/STL/OBJ/AR & video recording.
- **Studio Pro 4D** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/studio-pro/): 2D-to-3D Scene Composer, SVG/DXF extrusion, audio/video-to-3D, and standalone HTML/OBJ/AR export.
- **Vector CNC Studio** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/vector-cnc/): Trace PNG/JPG to SVG/DXF and generate GRBL/Marlin CNC and laser G-Code toolpaths.
- **AI Depth Maps** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/depth-maps/): Extract 16-bit depth maps and 3D relief meshes from photos for CNC carving and lithophanes.
- **Maker Studio 7** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/maker7/): Parametric laser-cut finger-joint boxes with kerf compensation and lithophanes.
- **Jewelry Maker Pro** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/jewelry-pro/): Parametric 3D rings, signets, gem bezels, and castable STL export.
- **Mech Gen Pro** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/mech-gen-pro/): Involute spur gears, planetary gearboxes, and sprockets to DXF/SVG/STL.
- **Studio 3D Viewer** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/studio-3d-viewer/): Measure in mm, slice cross-sections, and inspect STL, OBJ, GLB, GLTF, PLY, and 3MF files.
- **Architect Pro 1 & 2** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/architect-pro-1/, https://studios-pro.com/apps/architect-pro-2/): 2D/3D architectural floorplans and interactive house walkthroughs.
- **4D Music Composer** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/music-composer/): Audio-reactive 3D visualizers, polyphonic synth, loop sequencer, WAV & video export.
- **Zen Sandscape** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/sandbox/): Interactive physics sand & color particle simulator with offline HTML and 3D AR wall art export.
- **DFX Studio** (https://studios-pro.com/apps/dfx/): Free online AutoCAD DXF viewer, layer inspector, and vector flow exporter.
